info.name: ERP System API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the ERP System (Inventory & Sales Management).

Covers every controller endpoint: Auth, Profile, User Management, Products, Customers, Suppliers, Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, GRN, Invoices (+PDF) and Dashboard.

Requests are ordered by real business-flow dependency. Tokens and entity IDs are captured automatically into collection variables, so the whole collection runs top-to-bottom in Postman Collection Runner or Newman against a freshly started backend (empty database recommended).

Roles used: ADMIN, SALES_EXECUTIVE, PURCHASE_MANAGER, INVENTORY_MANAGER, ACCOUNTANT (all registered in the first folder).

NOTE: user emails include a {{runEpoch}} suffix (set by the first request) so the collection can be re-run against a database that already has users without hitting duplicate-email 409s.
